items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote October 26
items.text: I was attracted to AA because it excluded no one, and I am grateful for the lessons I’ve learned over the years: that we stop fighting anyone or anything; that it is the details of what I do that make me who I am; that my perception of life is ever-changing and evolving; that the basic ‘suggestions’ I heard when I entered the Fellowship have been a continuous part of my life; that as long as I stay an active member of AA, more will be revealed.
items.attribution: “More Will Be Revealed,” Portland, Oregon, October 1998, Voices of Long-Term Sobriety

items.heading: Cita Diaria con La Viña Octubre 26
items.text: Hablar de lo que me molesta me ayuda a aplacar el poder que tiene sobre mí.
items.attribution: “Juntos podemos”, Martinsville, VIRGINIA OCCIDENTAL, ENERO DE 1990
items.source: Lo mejor del Grapevine, Volumen II
